title: Rewrite Remodel Plugin to Wire the Full Photogrammetry Stack into the App UI
description: Rewrite remodel/plugin/rs/lib.rs (crate remodel-plugin) as the final integration step wiring the now-complete photogrammetry/videogrammetry stack (remodel_document's new RemodelScene schema + remodel_engine's ReconstructionEngine + remodel_image/camera/feature/sfm/dense/mesh/motion/geo/video crates) into the app UI via framework primitives only. Add Cargo.toml path deps on all new remodel_* library crates; drop kernel_3d_mesh if unused. Add ephemeral runtime state holding the live ReconstructionEngine plus frame/viewport/selection state, mapping EngineStage (fewer variants) onto remodel_document::ReconstructionStage (more granular, 18 variants). Implement the staged execution model: runReconstruction (decode PNG frames via remodel_image or push_video for video assets, build EngineParams from scene.params' 8 sub-structs, store engine in runtime, emit SetJob amend + DispatchAction advanceReconstruction), advanceReconstruction (advance(step_budget), map EngineStatus to SetJob, append sparse preview, on Done extract mesh/quality/geo products into SetMeshResult/SetQc/SetGeoProducts, commit collapses whole run to one undo step), cancelReconstruction, ingestion actions (importFrames/importFramePayload/addStream/removeStream/setStreamSync), calibration/GCP actions, 8 param-setter actions with typed arg forms, clear/reset actions, view-only runtime actions, exportQcReport. UI: extend remodel-main World3d window with points_json preview + camera pose markers, optionally add remodel-frames Canvas2d and remodel-report Table windows if primitives support it (documented simplification allowed if not), panels remodel.media/remodel.pipeline(must-have)/remodel.results(must-have)/remodel.parameters/remodel.calibration/remodel.tracks/remodel.qc, register all new operations/arg-forms, extend app_labels! EN/DE, keep OBJ/GLB/DWG exporters and add hand-rolled PLY + binary LAS 1.2 exporters. Extend the existing inline #[cfg(test)] mod tests using semio_framework_plugin::testkit: render smoke tests per body key, run/advance staged-progress test, arg-form materialization tests, cancel-mid-run test, undo-collapse test, PLY/LAS exporter smoke tests. Only touches remodel/plugin/rs/lib.rs and remodel/plugin/rs/Cargo.toml. Verify via cargo test -p remodel-plugin and cargo clippy -p remodel-plugin --all-targets -- -D warnings, both green (or document remaining gaps if blocked by unrelated concurrent breakage).
